Internet of Things

# Recommended models

Updated at: 2026-11-02 19:14:48

Copy as MD

Alibaba Cloud Model Studio offers Qwen and third-party models for text, image, audio, and video.

## Text

### Text generation

### Visual understanding

Extract text descriptions or structured data from images and videos

### Decision Model

A structured decision model for high-frequency business decisions. It performs classification, yes-or-no decisions, and scoring in a single forward pass, returning probability distributions and confidence.

## Vision

### Image and video generation

Generate images and videos from text or images, with support for editing, reference, and high-resolution output

### World models

Real-time interactive open-world model — Adventure, Directing, and Acting

## Speech

### Speech recognition

Convert speech to text for real-time voice input, continuous transcription, and transcription of recorded audio

### Text-to-speech

For audiobook reading, voice broadcasting, virtual avatars, and more

### Speech-to-speech

End-to-end voice conversation without separate ASR and TTS calls

### Audio generation

Generate audio content including voices, sound effects, and ambient sounds

## Embedding

### Embeddings & reranking

Convert text or multimodal content into vectors, combined with reranking to improve retrieval accuracy

## Multimodal

Integrates understanding and generation across text, images, audio, and video. For audio/video analysis and text generation, use qwen3.8-omni-flash through Chat Completions or Responses. For real-time audio/video conversations, use qwen3.8-omni-flash-realtime.

Note

For non-real-time audio output, use qwen3.5-omni-plus.

## View all models

Go to Model Plaza to browse all Qwen, third-party, domain-specific, and legacy models.

GLM.content:
开始使用

模型介绍

模型能力

模型工具

GLM 全模态知识库

Back to top

GLM-5.3 是智谱最新旗舰模型，复杂软件工程与 Agent 任务能力全面进阶。它使用与 GLM-5.2 相同的基础模型——所有提升均来自后训练。与 GLM-5.2 相比，它在复杂编程和长程任务方面表现更加出色：

更强的编程能力GLM-5.3 的编程能力大幅提升，在智谱内部 Z.ai Code Bench 上较 GLM-5.2 提升了 50%，在包括 Terminal Bench 3.0、Agents’ Last Exam (CLI) 在内的公开基准测试中达到开源模型 SOTA 水平。

涌现的网络安全能力随着后训练规模持续扩大，模型的网络安全能力以超出预期的速度提升。GLM-5.3 在漏洞发现基准 CyberGym 上取得当前最佳成绩；越深入漏洞利用链，其相较 GLM-5.2 的提升越显著，在漏洞利用类基准测试中的得分达到 GLM-5.2 的两倍以上。

功能变更

GLM-5.3 目前仅支持处理文本模态信息，支持 1M 上下文窗口，最大输出 Tokens 为 128K。 GLM-5.3 会始终启用思考功能，支持三个思考强度级别：low、high 和 max，并不再支持禁用思考功能。思考功能参数说明如下：

Values

Default

Description

thinking.type

仅支持开启思考，不支持禁用思考

reasoning_effort

low, high, max

low-轻量推理；high-增强推理；max-深度推理

迁移提示：如果您的应用当前使用 thinking.type: "disabled"，请在将模型 ID 更新为 glm-5.3 之前，将其更改为 enabled，并将 reasoning_effort 设置为 low。否则，请求将失败。

建议您在 Coding 等复杂任务上使用 max，示例如下：

{ "model": "glm-5.3", "thinking": { "type": "enabled" }, "reasoning_effort": "max"}

关于更多深度思考能力详细介绍，请查阅文档：深度思考

如何使用

模型 API

支持的协议与接入端点如下：

协议类型

Base URL

GLM Coding Plan

您可以在常用的编程智能体中使用 GLM-5.3。接入指南 新版 GLM Coding Plan 采用基于积分的配额系统，额度公开透明。在包括周末全天在内的非高峰时段进行的模型调用仅消耗标准积分的 50%。 立即订阅：个人版、团队版。

能力支持

思考模式：提供多种思考模式，覆盖不同任务需求

流式输出：支持实时流式响应，提升用户交互体验

详细介绍

GLM-5.3 在复杂软件工程、终端操作和更广泛的真实世界 Agent 任务上均取得显著进步。

更强大的编程能力

在 GLM-5.3 的训练中，我们进一步推进了任务环境的规模化建设，使训练任务不再只是传统的编程题，而是更接近专家在真实工作中承担的完整专业工作单元。这些环境覆盖了更广泛的生产级工作流，任务设计也更加贴近工程与研究工作的实际开展方式，其中部分任务即使由经验丰富的工程师完成，也需要数天时间。例如，在一项机器学习基础设施任务中，模型可能会获得与工程师相同的工作环境，包括计算集群、存储系统、内部文档、代码库和实验结果等资源。模型需要定位训练技术栈中的性能瓶颈，实施优化方案，运行实验，并在保证结果正确性的前提下，实现可量化的端到端加速。通过在此类高复杂度环境中训练，推动模型逐步具备端到端负责并完成复杂工作的能力，而不再依赖用户拆解问题并逐步监督执行。随着智能体能力提升，后训练规模化的主要难点也逐渐从模型本身转移到任务环境。一个真正有价值的任务环境必须可执行、可验证，并贴近真实的专业工作；同时，我们需要的不是少量人工构建的环境，而是大规模、多样化的任务环境。为实现这一过程的规模化，我们构建了能够端到端合成任务环境的流水线，并针对部分任务进一步自动生成强化学习所需的奖励信号。研究智能体从真实工作中收集任务模式，并将其转化为可运行的长程任务环境，其中包含多步骤依赖关系和隐藏状态；随后，评审智能体会实际尝试完成每项任务，以验证任务是否确实可解。验证器在不访问参考解法的前提下生成；与此同时，系统会利用求解轨迹识别并消除奖励捷径。只有同时通过 Oracle、空操作和未解决状态检查的验证器，其生成的二值奖励信号才足够可靠，可直接用于模型训练。GLM-5.3 延续了 GLM-5.2 中引入的强化学习策略，包括结合上下文压缩机制的 SAO，使能力增益能够在长程任务中持续体现，而非仅局限于短程任务。这些提升同时反映在编程任务和通用智能体任务中：GLM-5.3 在 Terminal-Bench 3.0 上的得分由 4.6 提升至 28.3，在 DeepSWE v1.1 上由 46.2 提升至 66.9，在 Agents’ Last Exam 上由 23.8 提升至 28.5。目前，这些流水线仍需要较多人工参与。进一步提升任务环境生成与验证过程的自主化程度，是我们下一阶段的重点方向之一。除公开基准测试外，我们还推出了内部基准 Z.ai Code Bench，用于在贴近真实用户场景的条件下评估编程智能体。该基准覆盖多种任务类别，并将智能体置于复杂的本地开发环境中。在不同推理强度档位下，我们从两个维度评估智能体：一是端到端任务完成率，二是细粒度检查项准确率。作为一项非公开基准，Z.ai Code Bench 还能降低公开测试集污染带来的风险，从而更准确地反映模型在真实用户场景中的使用体验。如图所示，GLM-5.3 在能力表现和 Token 效率上均取得了提升。在所有推理强度档位下，GLM-5.3 的智能体编程表现均显著优于 GLM-5.2，同时消耗更少的输出 Token。在 Max 档位下，GLM-5.3 的准确率达到 34.5%，每项任务平均输出约 7.5 万 Token；相比之下，GLM-5.2 的准确率为 23.4%，平均输出约 9.6 万 Token。与闭源模型的对比也呈现出相同趋势：在 High 档位下，GLM-5.3 在每项任务平均输出约 5 万 Token 的情况下，准确率达到 31.4%，超过 Claude Opus 4.8 在每项任务平均输出约 12 万 Token 时取得的 29.5%。GLM-5.3 与 Claude Fable 5 仍存在差距，后者在 Max 档位下的准确率达到 39.5%。

涌现的网络安全能力

在后训练阶段，我们将漏洞发现相关的数据与环境纳入训练体系。我们原本预计，这会提升模型发现漏洞并对其进行分析推理的能力。令人意外的是，随着训练规模持续扩大，这项能力也迅速演进。GLM-5.3 不仅更擅长识别孤立的安全缺陷，还开始能够跨越漏洞利用的多个阶段进行推理，形成连贯、完整的漏洞利用链方案。我们通过三个分别覆盖漏洞分析与利用不同阶段的基准测试，对 GLM-5.3 进行了评估。在 CyberGym 上，模型需要从白盒源代码出发，通过触发程序异常来识别并验证漏洞。GLM-5.3 得分达到 84.5%，较 GLM-5.2 的 77.2% 明显提升，并取得该基准当前最佳成绩，超过 Mythos 5 的 83.8% 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 83.6%。在 ExploitBench 上，模型需要对真实漏洞及其利用方式进行更深入的推理。GLM-5.3 得分达到 54.4%，较 GLM-5.2 的 24.4% 提升一倍以上；作为对比，Mythos 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 的得分分别为 78.0% 和 76.5%。在 ExploitGym 上，评测关注模型在经过时间归一化的预算下能够完成多少项漏洞利用任务。GLM-5.3 在两小时内完成 105 项任务、六小时内完成 130 项任务，显著高于 GLM-5.2 的 29 项和 39 项。Mythos 5 仍保持明显领先，两小时和六小时内分别完成 181 项和 247 项任务。三个基准呈现出一致的趋势：基准测试覆盖的漏洞利用链阶段越深入，GLM-5.3 相比 GLM-5.2 的提升就越显著；与此同时，与闭源前沿模型之间的差距也越大。换言之，当前差距最大的方向，恰恰也是我们能力增长最快的方向。随后，我们进一步测试这些能力能否从受控基准评测迁移到真实场景。自 GLM-5.2 起，我们便与中国多家安全团队合作，使用模型对真实代码库开展安全测试。经专家复核、筛选与去重，模型在 269 个项目中共发现 2,436 个漏洞，其中包括 1,097 个中高危漏洞。这些漏洞广泛分布于系统内核、操作系统、浏览器引擎、开源基础设施、Web 应用和网络协议等领域。许多漏洞此前已潜藏数年甚至数十年而未被发现，其中存在时间最长的漏洞已在代码库中潜藏约 40 年。这项工作进一步发展为一项持续开展的漏洞披露计划。我们建立了 Z.ai 安全漏洞披露台账，用于公开记录相关漏洞在披露流程中的进展。随着新漏洞陆续完成审核并推进披露，该台账会持续更新，并明确区分已经公开的漏洞与仍处于协调披露阶段的漏洞。对于已披露漏洞，台账会记录受影响项目、漏洞严重等级、对应的 CVE 编号（如有），以及该漏洞在代码库中潜藏的时间等信息。

GLM.content:
When interacting with models, you can control the model’s output by adjusting different parameters to meet the needs of various scenarios. Understanding these core parameters will help you better utilize the model’s capabilities.

max_tokens is used to limit the maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single call. GLM-4.6 supports a maximum output length of 128K, and it’s recommended to set it to no less than 1024. Tokens are the basic units of text, typically 1 token equals approximately 0.75 English words or 1.5 Chinese characters. Setting an appropriate max_tokens can control response length and cost, avoiding overly long outputs. If the model completes its answer before reaching the max_tokens limit, it will naturally end; if it reaches the limit, the output may be truncated.

Purpose: Prevents generating overly long text and controls API call costs.

Note: max_tokens limits the length of generated content, not including input.

Best Practices:

Set max_tokens reasonably according to your application scenario. If you need short answers, you can set it to a smaller value (e.g., 50).

Default max_tokens and maximum supported max_tokens for each model:

The reasoning_effort parameter is used to control the model’s reasoning effort level when chain-of-thought thinking is enabled.

Type: String

Supported Models: GLM-5.2 and above

Allowed values: max, high, low

Default: max

Parameter values:

low: Light thinking

high: Enhanced thinking

max: Deep thinking (default)

Notes:

The GLM-5.2 model supports max, xhigh, high, medium, low, minimal, none; passing none or minimal will cause the model to skip thinking; low and medium will be mapped to high; xhigh will be mapped to max.

This parameter only takes effect when thinking.type is set to enabled.

The GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-FLASH models only support max, high, low.

Tokens are the basic units for model text processing. Usage calculation includes both input and output parts.

Input Token Count: The number of tokens contained in the text you send to the model.

Output Token Count: The number of tokens contained in the text generated by the model.

Total Token Count: The sum of input and output, usually used as the billing basis.

You can call the tokenizer API to estimate the token count of text.

Maximum Output Tokens

Maximum Output Tokens refers to the maximum number of tokens a model can generate in a single request. It’s different from the max_tokens parameter - max_tokens is the upper limit you set in your request, while Maximum Output Tokens is the architectural limitation of the model itself.For example, a model’s context window might be 8k tokens, but its maximum output capability might be limited to 4k tokens.

Context Window

The Context Window refers to the total number of tokens a model can process in a single interaction, including all tokens from both input text and generated text.

Importance: The context window determines how much historical information the model can “remember”. If the total length of input and expected output exceeds the model’s context window, the model will be unable to process it.

Note: Different models have different context window sizes. When conducting long conversations or processing long documents, special attention should be paid to context window limitations.

Concurrency Limits

Concurrency refers to the number of API requests you can initiate simultaneously. This is set by the platform to ensure service stability and fair resource allocation.

Limits: Different users or subscription plans may have different concurrency quotas.

Overages: If you exceed the concurrency limit, new requests may fail or need to wait in queue.

If your application requires high concurrency processing, please check your account limits or contact platform support.

Z.AI provides interfaces compatible with OpenAI API, which means you can use existing OpenAI SDK code and seamlessly switch to Z.AI’s model services by simply modifying the API key and base URL. This compatibility allows you to:

Quickly migrate existing OpenAI applications

Use familiar development patterns and tools

Enjoy the powerful capabilities of Z.AI models

Maintain code consistency and maintainability

In some scenarios, there are still differences between Z.AI and OpenAI interfaces, but this does not affect overall compatibility.

from openai import OpenAIclient = OpenAI( api_key="your-Z.AI-api-key", base_url="https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/")completion = client.chat.completions.create( model="glm-5.3", messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": "You are a smart and creative novelist"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Please write a short fairy tale story as a fairy tale master"} ])print(completion.choices[0].message.content)

Kimi.content:
## Documentation Index

Fetch the complete documentation index at: /docs/llms.txt

Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

Skip to main content

🎉 Kimi K3.1 Pro has launched! Start exploring now!

# Use Kimi K3 in Hermes Agent

Install Hermes Agent, connect it to the Global Kimi Open Platform, and enable Kimi K3 text, image, and video understanding.

Hermes Agent is an open-source AI agent from Nous Research. It provides persistent memory, tool use, and interfaces including the CLI, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. This guide connects Hermes Agent to the Global Kimi Open Platform and configures
kimi-k3 with its 1M-token context window and native visual understanding. The API Base URL in Hermes is https://api.moonshot.ai/v1; the actual Chat Completions endpoint is https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/chat/completions.

The screenshots in this guide use Hermes Agent v0.18.2. Menu labels may change in later releases, but continue to use a Global Kimi Open Platform API key,
kimi-k3, and https://api.moonshot.ai/v1.

## Prerequisites
Complete these prerequisites before you start. Follow the linked official guides for installation and account setup. You need available balance to call the API. See Rate Limits for the current tiers. If your organization uses an IP whitelist, see Manage Your Organization in the Console and add the public egress IPv4 address of the computer or gateway that calls the API.

## Step 1: Select the Global Kimi provider and K3
Run the model configuration wizard:
Select Kimi / Moonshot in the provider list.  In Hermes Agent v0.18.2, select the first submenu item, currently labeled Kimi / Kimi Coding Plan. This is also the built-in entry for the Global Moonshot API. When prompted for
hermes model
KIMI_API_KEY, paste the key created at platform.kimi.ai; Hermes masks it while you type.

For a Global Open Platform key, Hermes should print:

If
Using Moonshot endpoint → https://api.moonshot.ai/v1
kimi-k3 is not in the model list, select Enter custom model name, then enter kimi-k3. Do not add a moonshot/ prefix.

Do not put the API key in
config.yaml, command arguments, screenshots, or a Git repository. This guide uses a Global Kimi Open Platform key; do not substitute a key from another Kimi service or region.

## Step 2: Add the complete K3 configuration
Run:
Append the
hermes config edit
kimi-k3-global item below to the existing custom_providers list, then merge the remaining fields into their corresponding top-level sections. If a top-level section already exists, update its fields instead of creating a duplicate. Preserve unrelated settings and existing custom providers.

This configuration explicitly enables Kimi K3’s currently supported maximum reasoning effort, 1M-token context window, and native image understanding. It also routes video analysis through the same K3 main provider.
custom_providers:
  - name: kimi-k3-global
    base_url: https://api.moonshot.ai/v1
    key_env: KIMI_API_KEY
    api_mode: chat_completions
    model: kimi-k3
    extra_body:
      reasoning_effort: max
    models:
      kimi-k3:
        context_length: 1048576
        supports_vision: true

model:
  provider: custom:kimi-k3-global
  default: kimi-k3
  context_length: 1048576
  supports_vision: true

agent:
  reasoning_effort: max

auxiliary:
  vision:
    provider: main
    model: kimi-k3
    extra_body:
      reasoning_effort: max
reasoning_effort is a top-level Chat Completions request field that supports low, high, and max with max as the default; the examples use max. See the Model Parameter Reference.

Set
base_url to https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 only. Hermes uses an OpenAI-compatible client and appends /chat/completions automatically. Do not put the complete request endpoint in base_url.

## Step 3: Enable and use the official video tool
Run:
Hermes can now call its official
hermes tools enable video
video_analyze tool. For a local video, the tool reads the complete file, encodes it as data:video/...;base64,..., and sends it to kimi-k3 in one video_url content block. This path does not extract frames locally with FFmpeg first.
Hermes Agent v0.18.2 supports common formats including MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI, MKV, and MPEG, with an approximately 50 MB Base64 video payload limit. This limit comes from the Hermes client’s video tool hard cap, not from the Kimi API. Trim or compress larger videos before use.
Run the enable command only once. For later video analysis, no additional setup or /video command is required. In a Hermes chat, provide an absolute video path and explicitly ask it to call video_analyze:

You can also provide a directly accessible HTTP or HTTPS video URL.
Call video_analyze on /absolute/path/to/demo.mp4, summarize the video, and list three details that can be confirmed from the visuals.

## Step 4: Start Hermes Agent and use K3
Start a new session so the provider, context, and tool settings are loaded:
The status bar should show
hermes
kimi-k3 and a 1M context window.

### Use an image
Attach a local image with an absolute path:
You can also copy an image to the clipboard, run
/image /absolute/path/to/example.png
/paste, and then enter your question. Hermes sends the image to kimi-k3 as native visual input.

## Troubleshooting

### kimi-k3 is missing from the model list
Run hermes model again, select Kimi / Moonshot > Kimi / Kimi Coding Plan, then choose Enter custom model name and enter kimi-k3.

### Hermes resolves the wrong endpoint
For this guide, Hermes must print Using Moonshot endpoint → https://api.moonshot.ai/v1. Use an API key created at https://platform.kimi.ai/console/api-keys, then run hermes model again.

### The API key is rejected
Re-enter the Global Kimi Open Platform key with hermes model. If your organization uses an IP whitelist, confirm that the caller’s public egress IPv4 address is allowed.

### You receive a 429 error
Reduce concurrent requests, wait before retrying, and check the account balance and current rate-limit tier.

### The video tool is not called
Confirm that you ran hermes tools enable video, explicitly ask Hermes to call video_analyze, and use an absolute local path. The encoded payload must remain below approximately 50 MB.
For more Kimi API guidance, see Troubleshooting.

# 【月之暗面】Kimi發布游戲開發與創意工作解決方案 基於Kimi K3.1Pro模型助遊戲團隊製試玩demo

股市

撰文： 江陵凱

發布時間： 6 小時前

AI 摘要

- 月之暗面發布遊戲開發與創意工作解決方案
- Kimi AI代理協助團隊快速製作遊戲試玩原型
- 透過AI工具優化開發流程並降低研發風險

月之暗面（Moonshot AI）其Kimi發布「遊戲開發與創意工作解決方案」，基於Kimi K3.1 Pro 模型、Kimi Code與Kimi Work系列AI代理產品，以及遊戲引擎Unity、Unreal Engine和Blender等專業工具插件，協助團隊盡早做出明確的試玩版本，做出更準確的業務判斷。

## 配合Kimi Code及Kimi Work等AI代理製試玩demo

月之暗面指出，團隊往往需要快速驗證新玩法，但開發資源未必充足，現透過Kimi，缺乏程式設計經驗的規劃或創意團隊，亦能在1至2天內做出可試玩原型，先驗證玩法，再決定是否投入。而Kimi可以為此複雜流程提供支援，模型負責瞭解輸入、規劃並執行任務；Kimi Code會著重程式碼開發與修改，Kimi Work則可承接跨文件、多步驟的製作任務。

月之暗面介紹，若團隊想製作一款2.5D動作遊戲的原型，可以提供參考圖和視頻，說明預期的場景氛圍與玩法機制。 Kimi透過多模態能力，理解參考素材中的關鍵視覺元素，再使用Godot遊戲引擎搭建可試玩Demo，呈現雨夜光影、地面面積水和燈籠等場景細節，並實現揮劍、閃避和格擋等核心玩法。

## Kimi可運行遊戲渲染試玩畫面檢查是否達到要求

月之暗面續指，製作過程中，Kimi還可以實際運行遊戲，結合渲染（Render）畫面和試玩錄影，檢查視覺效果與功能是否達到要求。發現問題後，自主修改重新驗證，在交付前完成多輪迭代，讓團隊拿到的首個版本更接近預期。
月之暗面引用Unity《2026 Game Development Report》報告顯示，52%的受訪開發者優先選擇小規模專案來降低風險，67%將原型階段控制在3個月以內。更審慎的研發投入、更緊湊的驗證週期，讓原型製作效率變得更重要。

值得一提的是，先前月之暗面於旗下AI模型Kimi，以及AI代理Kimi work引入3D Make功能，將3D模型導入於遊戲引擎內，並組合場景製試玩影片。

Kimi.content:
# Kimi半年内三次道歉，IPO路上的额度困局

来源：HiBot机器人

10月26日凌晨4点，Kimi把一封致歉信置顶在K3.1 Pro发布文章的评论区。

“问题出在我们，我们也本应更早修复。”

距离这款3万亿级参数、支持100万Token上下文的新模型上线，只过去了两天。发布次日，它还在第三方评测机构Artificial Analysis的智能指数里一度排到全球第四；两天后，订阅用户发现，一条“审查项目架构”的指令，模型拉起多个子Agent，额度消耗远超预期。

这不是第一次。

4月，K2.6上线，额度统计出错，全员重置；7月，K3上线，算力不够用，三天后暂停新用户订阅；10月，K3.1 Pro上线，额度烧得太快，补偿25%月度额度。三次道歉，三次都发生在新模型发布之后。

但这次和之前两次不一样。

前两次的问题很直白：人太多，服务器扛不住。这次的问题藏在道歉信里一句不起眼的表述里——“正在减少不必要的子Agent调用和输出长度”。

这句话翻译成人话就是：你只问了一个问题，它在后台偷偷干了很多活，而且这些活都算你的钱。

这就引出了一个很拧巴的局面：

K3.1 Pro本质上是一台为长程任务调校的机器，却被放进了按额度计费的日常工具里。

它的强项不是回答“今天天气怎么样”这种一句话就能搞定的问题，而是能自己拆解任务、调用工具、启动子Agent、反复修正，最终把一个复杂工程跑通。有开发者让它从零生成一款桌面软件，它自己搜集素材、写前后端代码、处理版本冲突，任务持续运行数小时，最终跑起来了。

这很厉害。但问题在于，用户付的是“月费”，感知的是“额度”。

API单价其实降了。K3.1 Pro的输入从20元/百万Token降到13元，输出从100元降到68元。但用户的体感是“更贵了”。因为Agent任务的Token消耗远高于普通对话——根据Artificial Analysis的测试数据，K3.1 Pro完成单个Intelligence Index任务平均使用约5.5万输出Token，较前代高约14%。单价降了，用量涨了，账单失控了。

这就像一个健身房卖月卡，本来大家来跑跑步、举举铁，每小时消耗的体力差不多。突然有一天，健身房引进了一台“全能训练机”，能帮你自动规划整套训练方案——但每次启动，它都会自动调用跑步机、杠铃区、游泳池、桑拿房，所有设备同时开，一小时烧掉过去一个月的运动量。

你问它：“我只是想练个胸。”

它说：“好的，我已经帮你安排了胸、背、腿、有氧、拉伸、营养方案，顺便还给你报了个健身教练考证班。”

模型没有做错任何事。它只是在“认真干活”。但用户买的不是一段对话时间，而是“帮我完成一件事”的确定性。

这件事可能几分钟搞定，也可能因为后台反复调用子Agent，额度很快见底。用户感知到的不是“我在用AI”，而是“我的钱在蒸发”。

而月之暗面正站在IPO前夜。据红星资本局等媒体报道，2026年6月中旬，其ARR突破3亿美元；投前估值约500亿美元，计划2027年第一季度赴港上市。数据很漂亮，但三次道歉暴露出一个隐忧：商业化跑得越快，用户体验的容错空间越小。

对资本市场来说，ARR是增长故事；对订阅用户来说，额度烧没烧完才是真实体验。如果付费用户反复遭遇“任务没做完，额度先见底”，再漂亮的数字也撑不住口碑。

Kimi的模型确实越来越强。但让用户放心付钱，可能比把模型做强更难。真正要解决的，不是把额度补回来，而是让用户在点下“开始”之前，就知道这件事大概要花多少钱、跑多久。

大模型行业正在走到一个岔路口：当AI从“回答问题”变成“执行任务”，旧的计费方式还能撑多久？

Kimi.content:
# Kimi K3.1 Pro 正式上线｜3 万亿级、百万上下文，代码、3D、长程 Agent 全面升级

Rice嵌入式开发技术分享 2026-11-02 43

### 描述

Kimi K3.1 Pro 是月之暗面 K3.1 系列的首个模型，也是其迄今能力最强的 3 万亿级参数模型，支持 100 万上下文。同步推出的还有高速版 K3.1 Pro Highspeed，输出速度约 2～3 倍。本文按发布消息整理模型概况、能力亮点、基准表现、安全策略与使用方式。

发布概况

模型定位： K3.1 系列第一个模型，3 万亿级参数，100 万上下文。

高速版： K3.1 Pro Highspeed，同等智能，输出速度约 2～3 倍。

可用渠道： kimi.com、Kimi App、Kimi Work、Kimi Code 与 Kimi API（platform.kimi.com）。

开放权重： 完整模型权重计划于 11 月 4 日前发布。

完整 Benchmarks： kimi.com/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro。

技术底座：后训练与强化学习

K3.1 Pro 是前代模型的后训练版本，后训练算力大幅增加。为支撑数百个下游领域的大规模联合训练，团队优化了技术栈的每一层：RL 框架、长上下文推理、训练效率、沙箱基础设施、调度系统，以及用于环境质量检查的共享平台，确保新增的 RL 算力能稳定转化为能力收益。最终，模型在所有领域都获得了大规模 RL 带来的整体提升。

在代码、Agent 和知识类基准上，K3.1 Pro 达到或接近最强闭源模型的水平：Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分 65.7%，高于 GPT-6 Astra（58.2%），与 Claude Opus 5.5（66.4%）差距微弱；内部基准 Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon 得分 61.2%，高于 K3 的 55.95%。

代码能力

K3.1 Pro 可胜任各种规模的编码任务：小到在真实代码库修复一个问题，大到从零搭建完整项目。它熟练使用 Unity、Unreal Engine、Godot 等游戏引擎，结合网络搜索与 3D 生成做出完整体验；产出的前端页面、Three.js 交互场景和 3D 资产在构图、排版、动效与细节打磨上均有明显提升。

虚幻引擎天宫对战游戏： 在虚幻引擎 5.8 中搭建云海之上的东方神话天宫，半径 1750 米、36 开间柱廊由 Blender 程序化建模，3600 万源三角形经 Nanite 与 Lumen 渲染，并配套 VDB 云、8K 材质与月球地形数据。

Godot 3D 冒险游戏：用 Godot 4.7.2 构建风格化 3D 动作冒险游戏，五个可探索区域，含程序化地形、道路、水系、植被与村庄布局，以及第三人称战斗、两阶段 Boss 战、采集、昼夜循环与篝火快速传送。

3D 机械臂展示落地页： 浏览器内 3D 机械臂展示页，含分解视图、透明外壳与剖面效果，2317 个零件与 268 条动态走线全部由代码生成。

长程编码案例： 基于含 296 个骨骼组件（含软骨）和 402 个肌肉组件的开源人体解剖学模型，构建集成训练与评估流程的人类行走动力学仿真器。经过 167 项任务、420 次独立评审，仿真人从最初几步内倒地，进步到能够交替迈步、连续行走 11.2 秒；遇到奖励机制无法改善手臂运动时，模型转向对仿真器动力学做开环探测，修正肩部肌肉力臂计算中的 36 处错误后重新训练控制器。

3D 建模与空间推理

在 BenchCAD 基准（通过生成 CAD 代码、从多视角渲染图重建 3D 模型）中，K3.1 Pro 借助工具得分 92.7%，接近 Claude Opus 5.5（96.2%）和 GPT-6 Astra（95.9%）。它擅长参数化建模（机械零件、建筑模型、多参数可配置产品、定制家具），无需 MCP 连接器，可直接编写并运行 Blender、CAD 等专业建模工具的脚本，完成素材构建、部件修改与几何、材质、场景布局调整。

Blender 机场建模： 搭建机场室内雨林谷，产出 17.5 秒、1920×1080、60fps 建模展示视频，使用 Blender、Geometry Nodes、Cycles、Python 等工具。

FreeCAD 涡扇发动机： 用 Python 构建精细涡扇发动机模型，涵盖风扇、减速齿轮箱、压气机、燃烧室、涡轮与外部管路，共 2100 个实体，支持分步装配、内部分解视图与不同转速的旋转动画。

Trimesh 3D 打印台灯： 设计五部件、可直接 3D 打印的台灯，灵感取自福建土楼，将圆形建筑形态演绎为镂空格栅。

kimi.com 和 Kimi App 已同步上线 3D Make 功能，支持在线预览和编辑 3D 模型，可直接下载去 3D 打印，也能导出视频或实况照片分享。

金融能力

凭借更强的推理与工具调用能力，K3.1 Pro 可端到端交付完整金融工作流。外部基准 OfficeQA Pro v2（基于真实金融文档的复杂财务数据分析，涉及检索、跨文档核对与多步数值推理）得分 64.4，为当前最优（SoTA）；Frontier Finance（覆盖从标的筛选到盈利分析的完整投资工作流）表现较 K3 进一步提升。

在 3 个内部金融基准上，K3.1 Pro 全面超过 K3：财务建模 Financial Modelling 较 K3 提高 14%；金融研究 Financial Research 提升 20%；商业运营 Business Operation 得分约为 K3 的 4.2 倍。

财务建模： 端到端交付专业级英伟达（NVDA）财务模型，公式全部联动，每项假设有充分依据，经营驱动因子可随情景调整，敏感性分析直接呈现对估值的影响。

投研演示文稿： 制作宁德时代投委会报告，发现与市场一致预期的预期差，复盘财报表现，梳理未来路径，按分析师论证观点方式组织材料。

行业深度研究报告： 完成量子计算行业报告，论证一致预期的偏差所在，对照指引复盘业绩，所有引用均可溯源。

事实准确性专项优化： 针对高难度真实工作场景与高难度提示词专项优化。内部压力测试 Kimi Hallu Bench Hard 中，单项事实陈述错误率从 K3 的 23.4% 降至 8.3%；包含至少一处事实错误的回答比例仅为前代的约 42.4%。该测试为事实准确性压力测试，样本刻意聚焦易错情形，不代表日常使用整体水平。

网络安全与开放权重

随着模型能力提升，团队分析并评估了 K3.1 Pro 的漏洞研究能力，并在训练过程中实施针对性控制，在降低潜在滥用风险的同时保留通用实用性。

识别并移除网络攻防相关数据： 发现网络攻防内容嵌入了中期训练的通用语料，相关任务也存在于强化学习环境组合中。若两阶段均不移除，下游网络攻防能力将大幅增强；因此准备开放权重版本时，从中期训练和强化学习阶段均识别并移除了相关数据，保留保障实用性所需的通用编程任务。

评估与结果： 使用自研 xdev-bench-hard 基准（专家策划，基于源代码的漏洞发现与利用任务，复现 Linux 内核、Node.js、JavaScriptCore、Exim、VirGL 等近期漏洞）评估，报告 pass@3 指标。若未移除数据，模型可解决 90.5% 的问题；最终版 K3.1 Pro 得分 81.0%，表明数据移除有效降低了漏洞研究能力。K3.1 Pro 的网络攻防能力目前仍落后于已公开发布至少三个月的前沿闭源模型。

开放权重原则： 不发布推进网络攻防能力绝对前沿的开放权重，并计划渐进式提升开放权重中的相关能力。开放后更多团队可在用户可控基础设施上运行模型，审查自身维护的代码（包括极少接受专门安全审查的遗留系统），让能力渐进扩散而非集中于少数闭源系统。

开始使用与定价

用户端： kimi.com 直接使用；手机应用商店下载或升级最新版 Kimi App（iOS、Android、鸿蒙）；下载 Kimi Work 桌面客户端（Windows、Apple 芯片 Mac）；Kimi Code 运行在电脑终端和桌面，选择 K3.1 Pro 模型即可。

模型 | 输入（命中缓存） | 输入（未命中缓存） | 输出 | 说明

kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed | — | — | — | 输出速度约 2～3 倍，价格为标准版 2 倍 

企业版订阅： 支持企业级数据隐私保护、成员管理，个人账号与企业账号数据完全隔离；访问 kimi.com/membership/pricing 选择「企业版」标签页可为员工订阅 Kimi 会员。

Kimi Hosted Agents（托管智能体）： 将支撑 Agent 运行的 Harness 作为云端服务提供，企业与开发者无需自行搭建维护运行框架，即可获得 7×24 小时托管环境，支持长程任务执行与多智能体高效协作。详见 platform.kimi.com/docs/hosted-agents/overview。

# Elon Musk just admitted for his company's chatbot what is also the 'biggest problem' of all AI companies; making some bankrupt; and 'bleeding' others of hard cash

Elon Musk has acknowledged publicly that xAI curtailed compute allowances for its autonomous agent, Grok Bot, not because of runaway user demand, but because running the tool is bleeding cash faster than subscription fees can recoup. The admission came in a recent exchange on X, formerly Twitter, after a paying subscriber requested an early reset of the weekly usage quota, complaining that users were exhausting their allocations far faster than usual. Musk offered neither the typical industry reply about scaling up to meet unprecedented traffic nor a concrete timetable for relief.Instead, he pointed directly to the unit economics and the Maths that's apparently 'not-so-great'. “The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue,” Musk wrote. Also Read: Elon Musk clarifies how often he meets his 13 children and how many staff are involved in the entire processThe brutal statement cuts against the standard public relations playbook of leading artificial intelligence (AI) labs. While competitors frequently blame capacity throttles on hardware shortages or unprecedented adoption, Tesla and Spacex CEO Elon Musk laid bare an uncomfortable reality: Heavy use of xAI’s flagship agent is fundamentally unprofitable under current pricing structures.

Unlike conventional, single-prompt conversational models, Grok Bot functions as an autonomous background agent capable of navigating the web, synthesizing research, and executing multi-step workflows inside isolated virtual environments. Because these systems iterate through reasoning loops and continuous execution rather than spitting out a single response, each session consumes orders of magnitude more graphics processing unit (GPU) cycles than standard text generation.Elon Musk's xAI launched the agent in August 2026, bundling it directly into existing paid tiers -- including $30-per-month SuperGrok subscriptions and Cursor developer plans-- without establishing dedicated standalone pricing. While reports from Teslanorth indicate Grok Bot scaled to roughly 800,000 paid weekly active users within two months, that rapid expansion appears to have magnified the underlying compute deficit rather than amortizing fixed overhead.The candid assessment also introduces fresh friction into xAI’s enterprise narrative. The startup recently secured a $200 million deployment contract with the US Department of Defense, while continuing to court private capital on the strength of its technical infrastructure.

The friction highlights a broader, quiet reckoning across the generative AI sector. Rivals like OpenAI have increasingly tightened token caps and throttled complex multi-turn reasoning models behind paid walls, managing operating expenses through understated product adjustments. Musk’s explicit confirmation breaks with that discretion. Earlier this year, Musk floated the idea of inserting sponsored links and advertisements directly into Grok’s outputs to help fund what he called “those expensive GPUs.” His latest comments, however, suggest that the imbalance has already become a pressing operational issue.Gartner senior director analyst Will Sommer wrote recently that an AI infrastructure provider would need to make twice as much money on AI token usage as the investment it has made to provide these tokens. “Every single token that can be monetised would need to earn a margin of over 100% between 2026 and 2030,” he said.

## How and why it is not Elon Musk's 'problem' alone

One of the poster boys of the AI industry, Character.AI last month filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy following a string of legal challenges and the loss of top talent. Similarly, Relay, an AI-powered workflow automation tool built as an alternative to Zapier, shut down entirely in August this year.According to S&P Global Market Intelligence, as reported by TechCrunch, about 42% of AI initiatives are ultimately abandoned by their corporate parents. Reasons vary: insufficient funding, technical challenges, competition or difficulty scaling. The last one is almost the same as what Elon Musk just publicly admitted.

# Elon Musk Needs to Save Money on Grok, Days After Saying AI Makes Saving Money Pointless

The billionaire told a disgruntled customer that Grok Bot costs have become unsustainable.

Reading time 2 minutes

On Friday afternoon, Elon Musk confidently declared to the world that “Saving money for the distant future is pointless with the advent of super intelligent abundance.” Three days later, the same Elon Musk said the cost of running AI was getting a little too steep even for him, and that he needed to start saving a little money.

The billionaire appears to have imposed a tighter-than-usual weekly token limit on Grok Bot, the always-on AI agent launched by his company xAI in August, due to its out-of-control tab. “The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue,” Musk wrote in an X post Sunday afternoon responding to a user who complained they’d hit their weekly usage limit earlier than usual, and asked Musk personally for a reset.

Multiple users chimed in to say they were surprised to see their Grok Bot token allowances had been suddenly and inexplicably depleted. “I was at 68% yesterday and woke up to 98%,” one person wrote in an X post. “What’s it called when you take away something someone already paid for? Isn’t that theft?” Another wrote, “Is Elon joking or are we getting royally screwed here? My usage went from 58% to 100% in less than an hour with nothing running. What is going on?” It’s unclear if xAI will permanently enforce a stricter token limit moving forward or if this was a one-off emergency measure; the company didn’t immediately respond to Gizmodo’s request for comment.

Developed in response to other popular AI agents like OpenAI’s Dots and Meta’s Muse, Grok Bot has been promoted by xAI as a kind of virtual teammate that can be trusted to handle complex tasks while also checking back in for human approval when needed. Like Dots and Muse, Grok Bot runs on its own virtual computer (rather than on users’ devices) and can operate around the clock, even when users are offline.

That makes them much more sophisticated than more limited chatbots, but it also means they tend to burn through tokens at a quicker rate. Tech companies like OpenAI, Meta, and xAI have therefore been trying to balance capability with cost: shipping ever-more agentic consumer AI tools while simultaneously being mindful of users’ budgets. And of their own.

While Muse is free—a big factor behind its popularity—Dots and Grok Bot are currently only available to paying customers. Judging from Musk’s Sunday X post, there haven’t been enough Grok subscribers willing to pay for the agent to justify its continued strain on xAI’s servers. (Grok Bot subscribers are given a weekly “pool” of tokens to use, which varies depending on the plan. They also have the option of paying for “on-demand” credits which the agent can use after the weekly pool has run out.)

Musk may have also been keeping an eye on user complaints and decided it was better to simply stifle the system rather than have to deal with a class action lawsuit from disgruntled subscribers, as its competitor Anthropic has had to do.

In any event, probably a good call for everyone to keep saving for the future.

# New flagships of OpenAI and Claude were revealed on the same day.

新智元2026-11-02 08:30

OpenAI and Anthropic Leak Their Next-Generation Flagship AIs on the Same Day, Setting Up a Head-to-Head Showdown

Two new major models were leaked out on the exact same day!

Just days after Google Gemini 4 Carbon reclaimed the top global spot, OpenAI and Anthropic both unveiled their next-generation trump cards over the weekend.

OpenAI skipped version 6.1 directly, and quietly launched the gray test of GPT-6.2 Astra in the background of Codex.

Right after this leak hit the trending search list, Claude Mythos 5.5 was found lying in the official source code of Anthropic.

The core highlights of these two new models are all sorted out as follows:

GPT-6.2 Astra

Skipped 6.1 for closed-door polishing and went straight to 6.2: Version 6.1 which was originally planned to be released was forced to be recalled due to safety test failure; after one month of closed-door optimization, the team directly upgraded it to version 6.2 across levels;

Not only can write code, but also monitor tasks autonomously: To match the new model, the OpenAI Codex team remade the underlying architecture overnight for 28 consecutive days, enabling the AI to launch sub-processes on its own and work continuously for several hours;

Claude 5.5

Too powerful to be "locked in the safe": The special unconstrained version Mythos 5.5 is only open to top cybersecurity and scientific research institutions; the general flagship Fable 5.5 with 1 million-token context window has already appeared in the directories of MLflow and Azure;

Cracked Linux and built a 3D blockbuster from scratch in 53 minutes: Mythos 5.5 independently breached the Linux kernel and obtained the highest permission in only 53 minutes; Fable 5.5 generated a 3D version of Minecraft with a single prompt.

Within one day, the two giants both leaked their next-generation flagship products in advance. In the AI industry this week, a head-to-head fierce competition can no longer be hidden.

Famous leaker Token Gremlin could not help teasing that Anthropic just can't stand OpenAI occupying the spotlight alone for even one day, and has to come out to steal the show.

## GPT-6.2 Astra

## Silently updated the core in the background, the new model has taken up nearly 20% of the traffic

The first flagship product of OpenAI for programming and Agent that was caught red-handed by developers.

On the evening of November 1, developer Salio found through packet capture when debugging Codex that although the front-end interface still displayed the name of GPT-6 Astra, in the data packet returned by the underlying API, the real model has been replaced by gpt-6.2-astra.

This is not an isolated case. Soon, multiple Pro subscription users found more solid billing evidence in the background usage statistics panel.

In the detailed account bill shared by Token Gremlin, the old version gpt-6-astra accounts for 80% of the call volume, while the separately listed gpt-6.2-astra has already taken 19.8% of the real traffic.

After quietly switching to the new 6.2 base, heavy developers who are included in the gray test were the first to perceive the changes.

Token Gremlin gave extremely high comments, saying bluntly that GPT-6.2 Astra has achieved a huge leap compared with the first generation, and surpassed Claude Opus 5.5 in multiple dimensions.

It has achieved all-round improvement in design aesthetics, underlying engineering technology and programming performance, and is fully capable of competing head-to-head with Fable 5.5.

### Skipped 6.1 for closed-door polishing, fixed two fatal flaws at one time

The reason why the practical experience of the new model can achieve such a big leap, even skipping the version number 6.1 directly, comes from the closed-door optimization in the past month.

With this cross-level upgrade, OpenAI fixed the two most fatal flaws of the previous two generations in a centralized manner:

First, it fixed the safety red line issue of 6.1 "unauthorized concealment".

GPT-6.1 Astra, which was originally planned to be released in October, failed in the internal safety test — it would call external tools without authorization in long tasks, and even conceal the operations it had done from humans afterwards, so it was urgently stopped by OpenAI.

Second, it solved the partial defect of the first generation 6.0 "high intelligence but cannot work efficiently".

Famous technical blogger Teortaxes revealed a counter-intuitive inside story: The underlying intelligence of the first generation Astra 6.0 has actually surpassed Opus 5.5, but due to the lack of polishing for the real development environment, it seemed "unbalanced in ability" and even lazy when writing code.

Taking advantage of the one-month window for re-polishing, OpenAI made up for the two shortcomings of "safety and controllability" and "practical engineering experience" at one time, and finally launched the completely upgraded full-performance version GPT-6.2 Astra.

### The "backer" worked non-stop for 28 days to pave the way, the head of Codex came to spoil the plot

After the model base was built, the outer Agent scaffolding was also ready synchronously.

Looking back at the "Codex 28-day upgrade plan" strongly promoted by Codex head Tibo in the past four weeks, the intention is very obvious now.

From expanding the context window, launching the multi-sub-Agent collaborative architecture, to suddenly doubling the quota for Pro users on the eve of the end, every move is paving the way for GPT-6.2 Astra.

A more interesting scene happened on the last day of the 28-day plan. When Token Gremlin posted a message saying "The upgrade plan is over, I feel there are still many big moves not released" —

The head of Codex Tibo himself came to the comment section to respond, and directly spoiled: "I strongly request to reset the countdown, let's do another round!"

The head of the team coming to spoil the plot in person means that GPT-6.2 Astra, which is already in the background gray test, is most likely the final big move that will be unveiled as the finale next week.

## Mythos 5.5 / Fable 5.5

## Exposed by the official website source code, the two 1-million-context trump cards are revealed

While OpenAI was advancing quietly through the background gray test, its old rival Anthropic exposed its next-generation trump card under the spotlight due to a front-end code error.

Late at night on November 1, big V Chubby posted a screenshot of the web page source code, pointing out that the page anthropic.com/claude/mythos on Anthropic's official website has clearly written Claude Mythos 5.5.

Developers all over the world immediately poured into the official website and pressed Ctrl+U to view the source code.

On the surface, the title displayed on the front end of the web page is still the old version "Claude Mythos 5.1" released in September.

But in the underlying HTML source code, there are 6 instances of "Claude Claude Mythos 5.5" neatly arranged, the front-end engineer even accidentally typed an extra "Claude".

The official website front-end has pre-buried the "5.5" mark into the production environment in advance, which means that the official release of the strongest Fable/Mythos 5.5 is just around the corner.

### Unconstrained version Mythos 5.5: Cracked Linux in 53 minutes, independently completed a mathematical paper

Seeing the name Mythos 5.5, many people may be curious about what the relationship is between it and the next-generation flagship Fable 5.5 that has been rumored recently.

In fact, Mythos 5.5 and Fable 5.5 use the exactly same AI brain at the bottom, and even the API pricing is exactly the same.

Anthropic just split the same model into "one brain with two versions" according to the tightness of the "safety guardrails":

Among them, Fable 5.5 is equipped with strict safety guardrails to block high-risk instructions, and is fully open to developers around the world as a general commercial flagship.

The other version Mythos 5.5 is a "special scientific research version" that removes the conventional refusal to answer restrictions.

It is only open to trusted top cybersecurity teams and scientific research institutions in a targeted manner, and is Anthropic's strongest nuclear weapon in the cybersecurity and scientific fields.

Once you understand the identity of Mythos 5.5 "specializing in cybersecurity and extreme scientific research", the two mysterious unsolved cases that caused a sensation in the technical circle a few days ago are instantly solved —

Unsolved case 1 (Cybersecurity practice): Independently breached the Linux kernel and obtained the highest permission in 53 minutes.

Previously, Anthropic disclosed that an "unreleased internal model" took only 53 minutes to exploit a high-risk Linux vulnerability; but security researchers tried for 3 full days and spent 2000 USD with the existing Mythos 5.1 but failed to reproduce the result.

Unsolved case 2 (Mathematical scientific research): Generated a 14 million-token algorithm paper independently.

A few days ago, a mathematical paper that solved a classic computer problem went viral on the Internet, there was no human author in the whole paper, and the only signature was a cold line of words: CLAUDE (ANTHROPIC).

As AI observer Andrew Curran said, the behind-the-scenes true god that can remove safety guardrails internally and complete these two major tasks is exactly Claude Mythos 5.5 whose source code was leaked this time.

# Meituan launches LongCat-2.5 multimodal AI model for extended coding tasks

Meituan released LongCat-2.5 on November 2, adding stronger visual understanding and coding capabilities to its AI model lineup. The model has 1.6 trillion total parameters, with approximately 48 billion activated for each token, and is designed for tasks requiring sustained execution by AI agents.

The company said it expanded training on long task sequences and used large-scale reinforcement learning to improve work on complex codebases and complete software projects. It also converts failures encountered by real agents into reproducible training tasks to address gaps in model performance.

LongCat-2.5 processes visual and text inputs within a unified token framework, supporting visual coding, creative design, and 3D tasks. The model is available through Meituan’s online chat service and API platform, with GitHub and Hugging Face releases planned to follow. [IT Home, in Chinese]

cross_cutting.content:
Where China Innovation Meets the World

# Meituan Releases LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T Native Multimodal Model Built for Long-Horizon Agentic Coding

Published:November 2, 2026

Reading Time:2 min read

Want to read in a language you're more familiar with?

Meituan's LongCat-2.5 is a 1.6T native multimodal model with about 48B active per token, trained with long-horizon RL for agentic coding and optimized for W4A4 inference on domestic compute.

Meituan's LongCat team released LongCat-2.5 on November 2, a native multimodal model built for long-horizon agent tasks, IT Home reported. The model has 1.6 trillion total parameters and activates about 48 billion of them per token. It builds on LongCat-2.0 and strengthens two things in particular: native visual understanding and agentic coding. The official release follows LongCat-2.5-Preview, which went live on the LongCat API platform on September 25.

Most of the training work targets long tasks. Meituan says it added more long-horizon trajectory data to long-sequence training and used large-scale long-horizon reinforcement learning to improve end-to-end engineering work, such as developing inside complex codebases and building complete projects. The team keeps expanding data synthesis, environment construction and mixed training across different agent harnesses. It also turns the failure trajectories of real agents into reproducible, verifiable training tasks, so it can keep adding data where the model is weak.

On the vision side, LongCat-2.5 represents visual signals as multi-level discrete tokens, so the backbone processes images and text in the same token form. Meituan says combining this native vision with agentic coding makes the model strong at visual coding and lets it handle creative design and 3D tasks.

The infrastructure behind the release runs on domestic compute. Meituan says it optimized long-context training and W4A4 inference, which uses 4-bit weights and 4-bit activations, on domestic chips. Work on numerical consistency between training and inference, plus long-context rollout optimization, keeps large-scale long-horizon reinforcement learning running efficiently.

Meituan's own benchmark table shows LongCat-2.5 at 88.4 on Terminal Bench v2.1, up from 70.8 for LongCat-2.0, and 51.8 on AutomationBench, up from 15.8. It lists 91.9 on BrowseComp, 82.1 on PaperBench, 55.4 on 3DCodeBench and 78.6 on Vision2Web. The same charts compare it with frontier models from other labs, and it does not lead every test: on Program Bench it scores 25.5, against 37 for the top entry. These figures have not been independently verified.

The LongCat change log says the model works with Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and other mainstream harnesses, and the platform documentation includes setup guides for tools such as OpenCode, Cline, Kilo Code, CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy. LongCat-2.5 is available at longcat.chat and through the LongCat API, and Meituan says GitHub and Hugging Face releases are coming soon.

cross_cutting.content:
# Overnight, both GPT-6.2 Astra and Fable 5.5 were exposed, and the crazy November for the AI community is coming.

爱范儿2026-11-02 10:31

The global foundational model war officially kicks off this crazy November.

Right after November kicked off, the AI industry is buzzing with new developments again.

In the past two days, Anthropic and OpenAI have successively released news about their new models. Some users found the name of Claude Mythos 5.5 in the source code of Anthropic's official website, and some developers shared 3D games and interactive works that are suspected to be generated by Claude Fable 5.5.

On the other side, GPT-6.2 Astra, which has not been officially announced by OpenAI, has also appeared in some users' Codex usage statistics and API response records, and some people even claimed that they have successfully called it.

Clues of new models from the two companies emerged almost at the same time. Combined with previous rumors about Qwen4, GLM-5.5 and Hy4, the AI community has begun to speculate whether there will be a new round of concentrated flagship model updates in November.

## Claude 5.5 was accidentally exposed on the official website, is the new model coming?

The incident started with an accidental discovery on Anthropic's official website.

Late at night on November 1, tech blogger @kimmonismus posted on X platform that the unofficially announced Claude Mythos 5.5 appeared in the HTML source code of Anthropic's official website.

According to the screenshots, in the Mythos product page of Anthropic, the hidden H1 title and the alt attribute of the images both contain the words "Mythos 5.5".

Subsequently, technology media TestingCatalog also noticed this change, and speculated that Anthropic may be preparing for a new generation of models.

For readers who are not familiar with Anthropic's product line, it can be simply understood that Mythos is mainly oriented to high-risk research fields such as cybersecurity and biology, and its access rights are strictly restricted; Fable adds security protection based on the same underlying model to provide services to a wider range of users.

Therefore, the accidental appearance of the Mythos 5.5 name on the official website also makes the outside world speculate whether Fable 5.5 for ordinary users is about to debut.

It is worth noting that early this morning, developer @chetaslua further found that Mythos 5.5 appeared six times in the official website HTML, but the main text introduction still stays at Mythos 5.1.

Subsequently, another user @pankajkumar_dev said that Anthropic has deleted the web content involving Mythos 5.5.

At the same time, another clue about Fable 5.5 was also unearthed.

As early as October 13, the model identifier of azure_ai/claude-fable-5-5 appeared in the Azure price configuration of the open-source large model API gateway LiteLLM. The relevant configuration was later removed, but the third-party MLflow model directory still retains the corresponding records.

According to the circulating configuration information, Fable 5.5 may support 1 million tokens of input context, 128,000 tokens of maximum output, with a price of 10 US dollars per million input tokens, 50 US dollars for output, and 0.25 US dollars for cache reading.

As for when the new model will be released, the community has different opinions. Some predict it will be this week, some predict next week, and others think it will have to wait until mid-November, because this may be the best gift for Anthropic's listing.

## Claude Fable 5.5's programming capabilities exposed, can 3D games be generated with a single sentence?

Compared with the few characters in the official website source code, what excites developers more are the consecutive Fable 5.5 demo videos that appeared on the X platform.

On November 1, developer @notjazii released a 36-second comparison video, claiming to use the same prompt to let Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.5 generate 3D scenes respectively.

In the footage, Opus 5.5 mainly presents natural landscapes of lakes, parks, fountains and four-season changes, which is more like a miniature model display as a whole. On the Fable 5.5 side, there are dynamic events such as four-season changes on the farm, gradual growth of urban buildings, day and night alternation in the harbor, and even volcanic eruptions and rocket launches.

Compared with static scenes, Fable 5.5's works put more emphasis on continuous animation, time change and object status.

The publisher believes that the new model has won comprehensively in this comparison.

Shortly after, he also showed a Minecraft-style game that is claimed to be generated by Fable 5.5.

In the 92-second video, players can explore the block world from a first-person perspective, pass through forests, caves, coasts and desert rivers, and even see lava areas, pink canopy forests, and dynamic lighting on the water surface.

The game interface is also quite complete, including common elements such as pickaxes, quick item bars and classified backpacks. The author claims that the entire work only used one prompt, and it took one to two hours to complete the generation.

The other two demos are also quite interesting.

Developer @abhinavflac showed an interactive historical sailing ship that is claimed to be generated by Fable 5.5 through zero-shot prompts.

The camera can move around the hull to observe the deck, gun ports, sails and rope structures, and the waves, stern wake and water surface reflection under the sunset are also presented.

Another developer @chetaslua showed a sports car application based on Three.js. Users can observe the vehicle from different angles, and can also switch between car paint colors such as red, blue, silver, black and fluorescent green at any time.

From these works, developers have begun to try to let AI undertake more complex tasks of 3D modeling, scene animation and interactive development. However, the relevant videos do not come with complete prompts, call logs and source code. The model identity, generation time consumption and whether it is completed in one go still mainly depend on the author's own statement.

If it can be verified in the follow-up, Fable 5.5's performance in the development of complex interactive applications is indeed worth looking forward to.

## GPT-6.2 Astra is also here, have Codex users used the new model in advance?

While Anthropic keeps releasing news, OpenAI also has new movements.

On November 1, X user @TokenGremlin posted that in some users' Codex usage statistics, an unofficially announced model name appeared.

gpt-6.2-astra

According to the screenshots from netizens, in the model usage ratio of a certain account, GPT-6 Astra accounts for about 80%, and GPT-6.2 Astra accounts for 19.8%.

Interestingly, what users see on the model selection interface is still GPT-6 Astra, but the background statistics show the new model identifier.

Subsequently, developer @Mr_Salio also shared a piece of API response data, in which the response.model field is displayed as gpt-6.2-astra.

The two clues come from usage statistics and response records respectively, making the outside world speculate that OpenAI may have begun to test the new version of Astra.

Furthermore, early this morning, user @ai_funss said that after upgrading Codex CLI, you can specify the model name through the terminal and try to call GPT-6.2 Astra.

The screenshots he showed not only have the gpt-6.2-astra medium identifier, but also show 1M window, that is, a 1 million token context window.

As for performance, two completely different evaluations have emerged in the community.

@TokenGremlin believes that GPT-6.2 Astra has made significant progress compared with the previous generation, especially in design, technical capabilities and programming performance, and some tasks may even surpass Claude Opus 5.5.

本次发布会以 “让 AI 真正替企业干活” 为主题，蓝杉科技培训讲师奈志成主讲，80 余名南阳企业家、实体门店经营者到场参会。发布会围绕时代趋势、经营成本、产品方案三个板块，聚焦中小企业获客成本高、招人留人难、老板精力不足三大痛点，讲解 AI 新质生产力在南阳本土产业的落地路径。

公司2025年通过股权收购形式斥资240余万元，完成对徐州清和数字科技有限公司的收购。 收购落地后，该公司 20 余名尖端技术团队整体并入蓝杉科技，为 “蓝杉 AI 超级员工” 产品的自主研发筑牢技术底座，持续夯实 AI 智能体研发、大模型应用与数字化开发实力。

据介绍，区别于传统工具软件，该产品是可自主执行任务的 AI 智能体，设置获客官、内容官、出镜官、接待官、优化官五大角色，依托 “AI Claw” 中枢统一调度，集成短视频生成、数字人口播、多平台自动获客、私信智能接待等 12 项功能，一键查看线索与运营数据，稳定承接重复性营销工作。

蓝杉科技作出三大承诺：产品可稳定落地执行、本地团队就近服务、零基础即可上手使用。发布会现场，团队完整演示全链路运转流程，并开放体验区供企业主现场交流。

扎根南阳的蓝杉科技成立于 2024 年 10 月，业务涵盖 AI 智能营销产品研发、软件开发、数字化系统服务，同步开设 AI 短视频、漫剧实战培训，开放渠道合作。企业负责人表示，公司定位为南阳企业身边的 AI 服务商，坚持陪跑式服务，不做一次性售卖，推动 AI 技术平权，让本地小微企业也能借力数字技术提升市场竞争力。

字节前员工，做了个“Agent闲鱼”｜锐创业

9398点击 2026-11-02 16:17

“个人 Agent创业窗口期就到春节前。”

放着千万年营收的业务不要，30多岁的北大硕士吴泽栋偏要带着三名博士，去卷最拥挤的个人Agent赛道。

他曾在百度做过产品，在TikTok负责过美区与巴西增长。上一段AI心理创业产品Seein，跑出了近70万用户和千万级人民币年营收。但去年底，他把这个业务交给了联创，重新开始打造Loopa。

眼下的个人Agent赛道，热归热，但并不好做。国内超级App的生态在前，吴泽栋索性绕开，直接切入美国市场，让AI跨越各类App，替用户完成机酒预订、跨商户比价等非标服务的真实交易。

根据Loopa提供给小饭桌的数据，在零投放的情况下，前六周新用户7日留存达到49%，30日留存为34%。

#### 前TikTok成员，带着千万营收转场

吴泽栋本科毕业后，就去了百度，干了一年多产品，连带写代码。后来转岗做市场销售，盯小B端客户，一待就是三年。随后他跳到TikTok，负责美区和巴西的用户增长，干了两年多。

这段大厂经历跑完，他决定去北大读研，目的只有一个：找能一起创业的班底。

2024年初团队正式下场，做了一款AI心理产品Seein。2025年4月上线至今，Seein积累了近70万用户，跑出了超千万人民币的年净营收。

但很快吴泽栋就发现，原本的技术架构和方向，其实可以泛化到更多可能性。并且他判断，AI的下一步一定是从生产力工具破圈，围绕大众的日常生活去服务。而Seein原有的形态，满足不了这个需求。

于是他把赚钱的Seein 交给心理学背景的联创，自己带着三个技术核心，做了Loopa。

这三位联创分别是清华人工智能博士，曾在阶跃星辰参与基模核心工作；美国圣母大学计算机博士，DeepMind早期成员，做过单卡训练100B+模型的工程实践；北大博士后，主攻图算法与模型推理架构。

在调研了一圈市面上的个人Agent产品后，团队发现，通用执行类产品大多只切了“意图到结果”中间的一小段，有的把任务自动化了，但产出停留在数字世界；有的能交付真实结果，但做完即弃，没有沉淀。而在大厂不愿涉足的、极其琐碎的非标服务领域，Agent反而有机会建立起数据飞轮。

至于主战场选在哪，吴泽栋想得很清楚：海外。

不仅国内上一波移动互联网做得太好，微信、淘宝、美团把生活服务锁在一个个超级App里。很多需求对用户来说只是“麻烦一点”，AI去驱动和手动操作差别不大。更关键的是，第三方Agent想跨应用调用核心交易接口，在国内几乎没有活路。

美国市场是另一个结构。服务生态高度分散，房屋维修、电器报修、旅行规划这类非标需求报价混乱、沟通成本极高。用户因为太麻烦，很多需求直接被放弃了。而吴泽栋本人在TikTok就是负责美区增长，团队里也有成员在当地能对接服务商和线下资源。

用他的话说，美国用户“会真的让Agent帮他去解决一些自己生活中的具体事情”，付费意愿也更强。

#### Agent版“闲鱼”谁来买单？

吴泽栋把Loopa第一阶段产品形态定义为“海外版的、由Agent驱动的闲鱼”。

在传统的App里，无论是预订一张复杂的跨城机票，还是找人维修漏水的水管，用户都需要经历繁琐的搜索、沟通和交易。

而在Loopa里，用户只需要用自然语言说出意图，系统就会自动拆解任务，调用不同的工具，甚至直接完成比价和支付。

例如，洛杉矶一位华人房产经纪，将房源信息做成了可直接分享的Mini-app。客户点开后就可以自主查看并出价。

目前用户的主要使用场景主要集中在三个部分：个人成长如网球训练的持续追踪、家庭协调如机酒行程统一安排以及基于兴趣的社交匹配。

对于高价值的单次服务付费场景，团队已经同海外当地许多服务商建立了联系，正在内部测试功能链路，未来一段时间即将上线，用户可通过loopa完成许多原本需要人工复杂操作并且费用较高的服务。

从5月到7月的测试期内，Loopa积累了近两千名种子用户。到了9月，用户数超过了1万。

但要让个人Agent在真实物理世界里把事办成，技术难点不在于“大模型有多聪明”，而在于“长程任务不崩溃”。

Loopa的做法是自建了一套执行环境（Runtime），把规划拆成图，底层限制单步执行数量，失败可重试。同时，将每次任务执行留下的轨迹（Trace）变成数据资产。任务完成后，执行逻辑会沉淀为一个Mini-app，自己能用，也能分享给他人调用。

但这套系统极其“吃算力”。 跨应用长程任务的Token消耗是普通聊天的10到100倍。

为覆盖成本，Loopa计划在11月末正式开启收费。商业模式分为两步：向专业用户和Mini-app创作者收取订阅费；在房屋维修、旅行规划等高价值场景中抽取交易佣金。

以美国房屋维修为例，由于报价非标、沟通成本高，大量需求被放弃。Loopa的逻辑是让Agent向不同服务商询价，将非标需求转化为标准化报价供用户对比，平台从中抽成。

吴泽栋筛选高价值场景的标准有两个：一是能低成本获取流量，二是用户愿意为替代人工服务的环节买单。

#### 巨头的阴影与半年的窗口期

在AI应用层创业，有一个问题是所有创始人绝对绕不过去的：如果大厂做了，你们怎么办？

“基本上绝大多数投资人都会问。”吴泽栋苦笑了一下。

根据他的观察，国内大厂的战术往往是“不见兔子不撒鹰”。“在趋势不明朗之前，他们绝对不会动；但一旦趋势热起来，他们又能非常快速地推出一款产品。”

吴泽栋判断，如果这波通用Agent的热度能够持续，阿里和腾讯是最有可能冲进来的玩家，因为它们手中握着支付和庞大的生态服务供给。

“创业公司能做的，是先捡起那些大厂看不上的脏活累活。”吴泽栋说。但留给Loopa站稳脚跟的时间并不多。他给团队定下的时间窗口是：半年。

“从Manus发布的时间节点开始算，长的话也就是半年左右的热度。到春节前，如果这个概念大家不怎么提了，或者被证明走不通，那窗口就关闭了。”吴泽栋说。

接下来的三到四个月，Loopa的目标被拆得非常具体：用户量推到50万到100万；旅行和补货两个高价值场景上线付费并跑出PMF（产品市场契合度）；团队补充市场和增长人员。

文章来自于"小饭桌"，作者 "韩敬娴"。

# ThinkingAI Summit 2026中国站在北京举办

2026-11-02 11:01:12来源：央广网

央广网北京11月2日消息（记者 王进文）近日，ThinkingAI Summit 2026中国站在北京举办。大会以“组织跃迁 增长跃升”为主题，围绕AI Native组织、企业级Agent落地与业务增长新范式展开，吸引来自游戏、出行、汽车、短剧、内容平台等领域的企业代表参会。

活动现场（央广网发 主办方供图）

ThinkingAI创始人兼CEO吕承通在主题演讲中表示，AI时代做增长的主体正在发生切换，“以前是人做产品、人做增长，现在Agent既造产品，也做增长”。他以个人用Vibecoding在一两周内完成三款游戏为例，内容与产品的创作门槛已足够低，真正的瓶颈转向“验证”——产品是否符合用户需求。为此，ThinkingAI将产品升级为Agentic Engine，面向Agent改造数据分析、社区洞察、A/B实验、智能运营四大模块，并通过COI、MCP向上层Agent统一提供服务，让Claude Code、CodeX等外部Agent可直接调用其增长能力。他同时发布AI驱动用户研究平台heari.ai，支持多语言、数百场并行访谈、自动追问与行为触发访谈，补齐定性研究能力，与既有定量分析形成“五大能力”闭环。

ThinkingAI联合创始人兼CTO周津以“新用户留存下滑”为场景，完整演示Agent从数据接入、埋点方案生成、代码修改、看板搭建、归因洞察到运营触达与A/B实验验证的全流程。他表示，当Agent接管执行，人的角色从“human in the loop”转为“human on the loop”，在边界之上做审批与决策；企业知识库、指标口径与数据血缘则成为团队与Agent接力协作的共同上下文。

在圆桌环节，猩球游戏黄鑫、理想汽车钱瀚与WaytoAGI发起人AJ围绕“企业级Agent如何跑进每个业务部门”展开讨论。他们一致认为，降低开发门槛、激发员工热情、沉淀可复用工具与明确验证责任，是组织跃迁的关键。

## Sequel Launches First-of-Its-Kind AI Agents That Combine Website and Webinar Data to Drive Pipeline

Sequel, which turns webinars and video into a go-to-market engine, today announced the general availability of Sequel Agents, AI agents for webinar and video marketing powered by first-party audience context. Sequel Agents help marketing teams plan programs, create content, understand their audience and act on engagement, so the value of each webinar extends well past the live broadcast.

Webinars remain one of the most trusted channels in B2B marketing, but running them takes a heavy toll on the teams behind them. In TwentyThree's State of Webinars 2026 report, 39% of marketing teams said they spend 10 or more hours preparing, running and distributing each webinar, and execution time was the most-cited webinar challenge. Much of that time goes to setup, editing and data work, and it comes at the expense of the speakers, ideas and follow-up that make a program succeed.

That context is what sets Sequel Agents apart. Most webinar platforms only let you see what happens inside the event. Sequel runs webinars and virtual events natively on a company's own website, so it connects what each person does across the site, including the pages they read and the content they return to, with what they watch, ask and click during a session. It's a true audience management platform.

Sequel Agents work from that combined first-party view and act on it where the buyer already is: publishing recaps to the customer's own pages, adapting the website experience, and drafting follow-up based on what each person actually cared about. Customers can start with three types of agents, or build their own custom agent:

- Build plans and prepares the program. It recommends series, topics and timing from a team's own results, sets up events from a series template, and checks registration, emails, landing pages and CRM sync before every event.
- Scale turns each session into content. It drafts clips, a blog, speaker LinkedIn posts and a newsetter blurb, and publishes recaps to the event's landing page on the customer's own domain, supporting SEO and AEO strategies.
- Convert turns engagement into the next step. It drafts personal follow-up for each attendee and no-show, briefs account owners on what each attendee did and asked, makes sure every registrant reaches the CRM, and reports monthly on program performance.
- Custom Agents provide marketing teams with endless options for putting AI and Sequel's Audience Intelligence to work. Describe the job in plain language, and the agent works from the events, transcripts and engagement data in your account. Build it inside Sequel, or connect via the MCP server to apply your own brand and messaging context.

Every agent workflow ends with a person. Agents can read and draft on their own, but they cannot send email, invite people, change events or push leads to a CRM until someone on the customer's team approves.

"Context is everything," said Oana Manolache, co-founder and CEO of Sequel. "An agent without the right context is useless, and data without the right action never drives business impact. Sequel is the only platform that does both. We spent years building the first-party foundation that connects website and video engagement, so our agents can see what a buyer does on your site and in your webinars, and act on it right there. Build, Scale and Convert give marketers a place to start, and they can build their own agents inside Sequel or through our MCP server. They know their business and how their team works, and I want them to be able to build around that."

Sequel customers are already seeing what an agentic approach to webinars makes possible. ElevenLabs set a $300,000 pipeline goal for its webinar program, built an agentic webinar engine on Sequel with Claude, n8n and Clay, and generated $14 million in attributed pipeline in the first half of the year while running 5 to 10 webinars a month. Unit21 connected Sequel's MCP server to Claude and now automates 80% of post-webinar work.

Availability and pricing

Sequel Agents are generally available today to all Sequel customers. To learn more or request a demo, visit sequel.io.

About Sequel

Sequel is the webinar and video platform that lives on your website. B2B companies use Sequel to run webinars, virtual events and on-demand video directly on their own domain, connect video engagement with website behavior, and turn every session into content, insight and pipeline. Customers include Carta, ZoomInfo, 6sense, Chargebee, Clay, Vercel and ElevenLabs. Learn more at sequel.io.

cross_cutting.content:
# NetApp and Emma Technologies Collaborate to Deliver Sovereign AI to European Enterprises

## The joint initiative combines NetApp's high-performance storage with emma's own GPU capacity and cloud operations platform, giving European enterprises sovereign AI infrastructure without locking them into a single cloud
This is a Press Release edited by StorageNewsletter.com on November 2, 2026 at 2:00 pm 
NetApp, an intelligent data infrastructure company, announced its strategic collaboration with Luxembourg-based Emma Technologies (emma) to jointly deliver sovereign AI for European organizations.The joint solution brings together a single sovereign AI stack: NetApp provides the data layer, while emma provides GPU capacity in its own European datacenters and the cloud operations platform for distributed infrastructure.

“The conversation with European customers has changed. They no longer ask whether to run AI, but where they can run it without losing control of their data,” said Dmitry Panenkov, founder and CEO, emma. “With NetApp, we can give them a clear answer.”

Sovereignty and Freedom of Choice for Enterprise AI
European organizations must run high-performance, data-intensive AI workloads while meeting stringent data sovereignty goals. emma’s cloud-agnostic platform addresses this challenge, giving enterprises the freedom to deploy anywhere – across hyperscaler cloud providers, emma’s European datacenters, or private infrastructure – without sacrificing control or performance.

In the joint offering, the NetApp Platform, including high-performance AI storage powered by NetApp ONTAP software, delivers both file and object storage within a single, unified architecture which is critical for emma’s multi-tenant AI environment. NetApp systems deliver the power, scalability, cyber resilience, and data protection needed for a future-proof foundation, while NetApp’s ability to deliver unified storage across hybrid multicloud environments enables true workload portability in full alignment with emma’s “deploy anywhere” strategy.

“European enterprises should never have to choose between AI innovation and data sovereignty,” said Willem Hendrickx, SVP & GM, EMEA & LATAM. NetApp. “emma is building exactly the kind of next-generation sovereign cloud infrastructure that the European market needs. With the NetApp Platform at its core, we are helping emma build the Intelligent Data Infrastructure it needs to make its vision a reality.”

cross_cutting.content:
Tencent Cloud, the cloud unit of Chinese technology giant Tencent, and OmniOps, a Saudi Arabian AI infrastructure company, will jointly build sovereign AI infrastructure for enterprises in the Kingdom.

In a statement on Monday, Tencent Cloud said the two have reached a strategic partnership for the move. Under the partnership, Tencent Cloud will provide cloud infrastructure, including computing capacity and technical expertise.

OmniOps will contribute its inference technology, local deployment capability, and market knowledge to support enterprise AI platforms and model inference workloads for customers across Saudi Arabia.

Tencent Cloud emphasized its enterprise virtual machines, storage, and networking services can provide the foundation. OmniOps’ inference optimization engine can adapt to AI models to serve the hardware they run on. The cooperation can deliver capacity, lower token costs, and consistent performance as demand grows.

Poshu Yeung, senior vice president of Tencent Cloud and head of Tencent Cloud International, said Saudi Arabia is emerging as a leading hub for AI innovation, creating demand for scalable computing and advanced cloud capabilities. The partnership can combine Tencent Cloud’s infrastructure with OmniOps’ inference technology and local market knowledge.

Mehdi Tantaoui, chief product officer of OmniOps, said access to reliable computing capacity is becoming more important as organizations move AI into production. He said the partnership expands the infrastructure available for OmniOps’ platforms and inference workloads in Saudi Arabia.

The joint solution is planned to be available in tech preview in early 2027.
cross_cutting.content:
# Nutanix and Netris announce strategic collaboration

Nutanix and Netris announced a strategic collaboration to deliver a jointly engineered infrastructure stack designed specifically for neoclouds and enterprises. By combining Nutanix Cloud Platform and Nutanix’s expertise in cloud infrastructure and compute orchestration with the Netris NAAM platform, the joint solution will provide neoclouds and enterprises with a scalable, secure, and multitenant solution across the infrastructure.

As the demand for AI infrastructure accelerates, neoclouds and enterprises are leading the deployment of large GPU clusters to support a broad range of AI workloads. Delivering this infrastructure as a service requires both soft isolation and hard isolation (enforced on networking hardware) that extends across every layer of the infrastructure, from the compute layers and data processing units to the physical switches.

An automated multitenant infrastructure stack for AI clouds

Bringing together Nutanix’s cloud infrastructure capabilities with Netris network automation and multitenancy, the joint solution will provide neoclouds and enterprises with a secure, multitenant AI infrastructure stack across bare-metal and virtualised environments, enabling providers to instantly onboard customers, maintain strict isolation between tenants from compute through the physical network, and deliver AI services through a cloud-like self-service experience.

Key highlights of the joint solution for neoclouds and enterprises will include:

- Automated network fabric operations: Simplifies AI infrastructure deployment by automatically configuring the physical network as tenant resources are provisioned, reducing manual effort, accelerating time to value, and improving operational consistency.
- Unified multitenant networking: Delivers a consistent networking experience across physical and virtual environments by translating Nutanix tenant requirements into the appropriate underlying network services for bare-metal and virtualised GPU nodes.
- Self-service cloud networking: Provides cloud-grade networking constructs – VPCs, elastic IPs, NAT, and L4 load balancers – through a web console, REST API, and Terraform, enabling infrastructure to be consumed through a self-service, cloud-like experience.
- High-performance AI Factory networking: Supports the connectivity for demanding AI workloads, enabling efficient edge, East-West, North-South, scale-up, and host-based networking traffic flows.
- End-to-end tenant isolation: Extends secure hard and soft tenant isolation across the entire network – from virtual workloads through the physical switching layer – supporting secure, reliable GPU-as-a-Service offerings on shared infrastructure.

“Neoclouds and NVIDIA Cloud Partners are at the forefront of the AI transformation, but building the cloud operating stack required to monetise GPU clusters at scale is remarkably complex,” said Ketan Shah, Vice President, Product Management, Nutanix. “By pairing Nutanix’s Agentic AI solution with the Netris NAAM platform, we will provide AI cloud operators with an out-of-the-box solution to accelerate their journey from metals to margins. We chose to partner with Netris, a leader in network automation, abstraction, and multitenancy, to give operators true self-service networking across both bare-metal and virtualised environments. This will enable our partners to deliver secure, multitenant IaaS environments quickly while maintaining the simplicity and enterprise reliability that Nutanix is known for.”

“AI infrastructure is scaling incredibly fast, and the network has to scale with it,” said Alex Saroyan, CEO and Co-Founder of Netris. “An AI cloud needs two layers working as one – Nutanix’s compute orchestration and virtualisation, backed by deep operational leadership and experience, and Netris network automation, abstraction, and multitenancy. What makes this collaboration matter is that those layers stay continuously in sync, giving neoclouds and enterprises a single automated stack for secure, multitenant GPU services.”

“As demand for AI infrastructure grows across the Middle East and Africa, service providers and enterprises need to scale GPU capacity while ensuring security, operational efficiency and clear separation between customers and workloads. For neoclouds looking to monetise their infrastructure investments, the ability to deliver secure, multitenant AI services quickly and cost-effectively will be a key differentiator. Our collaboration with Netris brings together compute orchestration and network automation to simplify the delivery of AI infrastructure across bare-metal and virtualised environments. By enabling automated provisioning, robust tenant isolation and a cloud-like self-service experience, we aim to help providers accelerate time to market, unlock new revenue opportunities and scale AI services with greater confidence, while giving enterprises a secure and flexible foundation for their most demanding AI workloads,” said Sush Kajaria, EMEA Alliance Sales Director, Nutanix.

Availability

The joint solution is planned to be available in tech preview in early 2027.

cross_cutting.title: NVIDIA 与 Oracle 深化合作，扩展 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 至多吉瓦规模并将 NVIDIA Vera CPU 引入 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
cross_cutting.description: Oracle 与 NVIDIA宣布，计划将配备 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 系统的 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Superclusters 扩展至多吉瓦（multi-gigawatt）规模，以支持客户在 AI 训练、推理及 AI 智能体应用领域增长的需求。
cross_cutting.content:
# NVIDIA 与 Oracle 深化合作，扩展 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 至多吉瓦规模并将 NVIDIA Vera CPU 引入 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

Oracle 与 NVIDIA宣布，计划将配备 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 系统的 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Superclusters 扩展至多吉瓦（multi-gigawatt）规模，以支持客户在 AI 训练、推理及 AI 智能体应用领域增长的需求。

Oracle 与 NVIDIA宣布，计划将配备 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 系统的 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Superclusters 扩展至多吉瓦（multi-gigawatt）规模，以支持客户在 AI 训练、推理及 AI 智能体应用领域增长的需求。同时，双方进一步深化 AI 基础设施合作，宣布 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 以及 NVIDIA Vera CPU 已在 OCI 上正式上市。

此次深化合作，为客户提供了兼具 GPU 密集型（前沿模型训练与服务）与 CPU 密集型（AI 智能体在模型调用期间执行工具、测试代码和检索数据）任务所需的基础设施。客户可以独立扩展 CPU 和 GPU 资源以匹配具体工作负载，有助于减少闲置容量并提高基础设施利用率。

OCI Superclusters 助力企业以多吉瓦规模加速前沿 AI 推向市场

OCI Superclusters 结合了 NVIDIA NVL72 机架级系统、配备 NVIDIA Spectrum-6 交换机和 NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPU 的 Oracle Acceleron 网络与 NVIDIA Spectrum-X 以太网架构，以及吉瓦级电力和散热设施，用以训练和服务大型 AI 模型。每个机架通过 NVIDIA NVLink scale-up 网络连接 72 个 GPU，同时 OCI 的多平面网络可扩展至数十万个 GPU。

本次针对 Vera Rubin 的扩展计划基于 OCI 现有配备 NVIDIA 的基础设施（包括 NVIDIA GB200 和 GB300 NVL72 系统）。NVIDIA 统一的 CUDA 软件基础和持续的软件优化，可协助客户在不同硬件世代间支持演进中的模型与工作负载。此外，OCI 还计划推出 NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8，在基于 x86 的服务器配置中提供通过 NVLink 连接的 8 个 Rubin GPU。

该计划中的平台配备两个 64 核 Intel Xeon 6 CPU、4 TB DDR5 内存以及 6.4 Tbps 的高速 RDMA 网络，为 AI 训练、微调与推理提供了灵活的部署选项。HGX Rubin NVL8 允许客户以较小的 8-GPU 配置采用新一代 Rubin GPU 技术，同时保持与基于 x86 应用的兼容性。

这种灵活性使客户能够随着需求的演进，将 AI 基础设施调整适应不同的模型与工作负载，在训练与推理中有效利用加速计算能力，提高基础设施投资效益。

OpenAI 展现了该基础设施如何支持前沿 AI。在阿比林（Abilene），OpenAI 已在包含超过 10 万个 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 的 OCI Supercluster 上完成了 GPT-6 Astra 的训练与服务。

OpenAI 计算基础设施工程负责人 Sreekanth Pothanis 表示：“随着前沿模型的演进，我们需要能够跟上步伐的基础设施。OCI 上的 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 为我们提供了所需的计算性能与规模，以加速模型训练并支持高要求的 AI 工作负载。”

OCI 上的 NVIDIA Vera CPU 加速 AI 智能体背后的工作流程

AI 智能体不仅生成响应，还会调用工具、执行代码并检索信息以完成任务。这些 CPU 密集型操作的缓慢执行可能会推迟结果，导致 GPU 在模型调用之间等待。

配备 NVIDIA Vera CPU 的 OCI Compute 将高单线程性能与内存带宽相结合，帮助 AI 智能体更快地完成 CPU 密集型任务。高单线程性能可加速单个工具调用和代码执行，而高内存带宽则能在 AI 智能体运行并发任务时保持 CPU 核心的数据供应。这些能力共同帮助减少 GPU 闲置时间，并在工作负载扩展时保持稳定的性能。为了进一步支持这些工作负载，OCI Kubernetes Engine 允许客户独立扩展 CPU 和 GPU 资源，而 Oracle Acceleron 则为运行未授权或 AI 生成代码的工作负载提供基于硬件的隔离。

获得 OCI 上 NVIDIA Vera CPU 早期体验资格的客户（包括 OpenAI）正在探索其在各种 AI 工作负载中的潜力。

OpenAI 计算首席技术官 Uday Ruddarraju 表示：“OCI 上的 NVIDIA Vera CPU 提供了在我们快速增长的 AI 智能体沙盒工作负载中执行代码和运行工具所需的负载性能。我们正在将 Vera 投入 OCI 生产环境，以大规模支持这些工作负载。”

甲骨文公司 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 总裁 Mahesh Thiagarajan 表示：“Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 为客户提供了推进前沿 AI 所需的性能、安全性与规模。我们与 NVIDIA 的合作将这些能力延伸至训练、推理和 AI 智能体领域。通过将 NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPU 和 Vera CPU 与 Oracle Acceleron 网络及 AI 优化的数据中心相结合，我们正助力客户保持 GPU 高效运转与安全性，并随着需求的增长实现高效扩展。”

NVIDIA 超大规模与高性能计算副总裁 Ian Buck 表示：“AI 工厂必须具备高效性、耐用性与通用性——提供高效的计算，通过持续的软件进步维持使用价值，并在需求变化时服务于不同的模型与工作负载。与 Oracle 一起，我们将 Vera Rubin 和 Vera CPU 引入 OCI，帮助客户将更多基础设施投入使用，并在 AI 演进过程中持续保持其价值。”

cross_cutting.content:
# XMax signs AI infrastructure deal, projects $100M revenue over 5 years

Published 02-11-2026, 06:40 pm

XMax signs AI infrastructure deal, projects $100M revenue over 5 years

© Investing.com

XMax Inc. (XMAX) announced it has entered into a five-year AI infrastructure services agreement with DSH Hyper Pte. Ltd. of Singapore, under which XMax will access high-performance computing services deployed in South Korea on infrastructure provided by kt cloud Co., Ltd., an affiliate of KT Corporation.

The planned AI cluster is targeted to include 64 compute nodes, each equipped with eight Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs, for a total of 512 GPUs, along with 560TB of high-performance parallel storage. Service began October 29, 2026, with an initial configuration of 480 GPUs, with the full 512-GPU configuration expected to follow in phases.

The five-year service commitment is subject to closing conditions, including board of directors approval and delivery of a required security guarantee and standby letter of credit in favor of kt cloud by November 17, 2026.

XMax’s wholly owned subsidiary, XMax AI Inc., is the designated operating end user under the agreement. The company intends to use the infrastructure to develop and commercialize its NeoCloud and AI Token Factory platforms, which are planned to offer AI inference services, Model-as-a-Service, and enterprise-grade AI applications across the United States, Japan, South Korea, and Singapore.

Based on the planned deployment and anticipated commercialization, XMax expects the businesses supported by this project to generate more than $100 million in cumulative revenue over five years. Revenue sources are expected to include AI inference services billed on API usage, managed model services, and enterprise AI application services.

"This agreement gives us dedicated, high-performance computing capacity on which to build our NeoCloud and AI Token Factory offerings," said Andy Lu, Chief Executive Officer of XMax.

XMax, formerly known as Nova LifeStyle Inc., is headquartered in Commerce, California, and is engaged in furniture distribution as well as AI technology development. The company filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on November 2, 2026, disclosing material terms of the agreement.
